zh: 元素都不超过 50 < 64，任意多个元素的异或结果都落在 0..63，只有 64 种状态。
按位置做动态规划：dp[x] 表示已经填好的前缀异或为 x 的序列数，每加入一个元素就枚举它的取值 0..M 做转移。
dp[0]=1；重复 N 次：新数组 nxt 全 0，对每个旧状态 old 和每个 v∈[0, M]，把 dp[old] 加到 nxt[old^v]，并对 998244353 取模；最后输出 dp[X]。
en: Every element is at most 50 < 64, so the XOR of any number of elements lies in 0..63; there are only 64 states.
Do dynamic programming over positions: dp[x] is the number of filled prefixes whose XOR is x, and each new element enumerates its value 0..M as the transition.
Set dp[0] = 1; repeat N times: start nxt at all zeros, and for every old state and every v in [0, M] add dp[old] to nxt[old^v] modulo 998244353; print dp[X] at the end.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Maintain a DP over the XOR states 0..63. For each new element, move every old state to old XOR value for each value∈[0,M].

## Proof of correctness

DP[i][x] is the number of sequences whose first i positions XOR to x. The value of the last element uniquely determines the previous state x XOR value; summing over values enumerates every valid last element, so the transition counts each sequence exactly once. The answer is DP[N][X].

## Complexity

Time O(N·64·(M+1)), space O(64).
